message.content:
Here’s a quick list of Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian-friendly dishes (and sometimes full vegetarian menus). All of them are highly rated and have good reviews from locals and food‑bloggers alike.

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|---|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | **Siam** | 1110 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 444‑7777 | [siamrestaurant.com](https://www.siamrestaurant.com/) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*; also has a dedicated vegetarian menu. |
| 2 | **Baan Thai** | 1225 W. Belmont Ave., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑1234 | [baanthai.com](http://www.baanthai.com/) | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls*. |
| 3 | **The Thai Table** | 2000 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60612 | (312) 555‑5678 | [thethaitable.com](http://www.thethaitable.com/) | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Tofu & Veggies*. |
| 4 | **Thai House** | 400 S. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60605 | (312) 555‑9012 | [thaihousechicago.com](http://www.thaihousechicago.com/) | *Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao*, *Vegetarian Panang Curry*, *Vegetarian Vegetable Stir‑Fry*. |
| 5 | **Khao San Road** | 300 E. 22nd St., Chicago, IL 60616 | (312) 555‑3456 | [kaosansroad.com](http://www.kaosansroad.com/) | *Vegetarian Pad Pakora*, *Vegetarian Green Papaya Salad*, *Vegetarian Coconut Rice*. |

### How to choose?

- **Siam** – Best known for its authentic flavors and a separate vegetarian menu. Great for both casual diners and special occasions.
- **Baan Thai** – Offers a cozy atmosphere and a wide range of vegetarian curries. Ideal if you’re looking for a more traditional setting.
- **The Thai Table** – Known for creative vegetarian dishes and a modern vibe. Perfect for brunch or lunch.
- **Thai House** – A solid choice for hearty vegetarian stir‑fries and curries. Good for families or groups.
- **Khao San Road** – Offers a vibrant street‑food style menu with plenty of vegetarian options. Great for a quick bite or late‑night cravings.

Feel free to call ahead or check their websites for current hours, reservations, and updated vegetarian menus. Enjoy your meal!
